title: Запиннить official MCP suite и выпустить applicability/scenario receipts
summary: Построить воспроизводимый official MCP evidence contour: exact prerelease pin, generated `2026-07-28` applicability matrix, public-boundary Dart client driver и raw receipts только для действительно applicable scenarios.
why: F08 is real: the existing Agentools harness cannot establish MCP wire conformance. Conversely, this repository has no MCP server/general SDK, so running or baselining a full suite would manufacture a green claim. Stable suite 0.1.16 also lacks the target requirement-set selector. `RAG:✅` in `@plan/knowledge/research-P6-design-rag.json`.

include: Exact npm pin/integrity/lock; offline-installable dev harness; frozen requirement inventory; classification of every scored/not-scored row; applicability schema/reasons; Dart wrapper conformance client for reachable tool/request-metadata/schema-preservation/MRTR-task boundaries; raw stdout/stderr/checks receipts; stale applicability detection; honest summary vocabulary.
exclude: New MCP server or PHP transport; implementing auth/prompts/resources to improve counts; treating dependency internals as Agentools surface; whole-suite expected-failure baseline; certification/Tier claim; Agentools semantic tests; public package dependency on Node; floating version/main branch; CI permissions/supply-chain automation owned by P9.

reads.why: Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.
Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.

rules: Package pin is exact `0.2.0-alpha.11` plus recorded integrity; `latest`, `main` and stable `0.1.16` are forbidden substitutes. Generate inventory from `list --requirements 2026-07-28`; every row gets role, scored class, applicability, reason and receipt path. No MCP server means all server rows are `non_applicable`, never pass. Applicable client scenarios must traverse Agentools-owned public wrapper types. `blocked_dependency` is red/nonterminal for an intended boundary. Raw suite receipts are immutable inputs to the summary. Expected failures remain failures and cannot express non-applicability. Summary phrase is exactly “official MCP scenario compatibility”; certification/Tier/full-SDK language is rejected by a text gate.
guidance: Keep the scenario driver in `tool/`, outside package exports. Dispatch on the suite-provided scenario environment without exposing test-only switches in library APIs. Store a compact normalized summary plus raw result directories. Verify the package lock/integrity before execution and avoid any network after install cache preparation.
deliverables: Reproducible official-suite dev pin, total applicability matrix, bounded public-boundary scenario driver, raw receipts and honest official MCP compatibility report.

result.notes:
MCP pin 0.2.0-alpha.11; applicability matrix 89 rows; tools_call receipt; summary official MCP scenario compatibility.
write-site: pre_mutation: allow · pre_final: allow
